apod.explanation: The Witch Head Nebula (IC 2118), about 50 light-years across, is gas and dust eroded by the nearby bright star Rigel in Orion. Its blue color comes from Rigel's intense blue starlight, scattered more efficiently by the dust grains — the same process that makes Earth's daytime sky blue.
apod.title: Rigel and the Witch Head Nebula

items.body: IRGC Navy says 3 tankers exploded or caught fire Sunday after hitting mines on an "unauthorized route"; Iran's Navy separately claims a 4th. Reuters could not confirm any of the strikes. UKMTO verified one outbound tanker hit by an unidentified projectile 15 km NW of Khasab, Oman (Nov 8), crew safe.
items.headline: Tanker claims grow, none independently confirmed

items.body: Iranian state media claim IRGC destruction of southern navigational aids has halted unmonitored night transits — unverified. A Sri Lankan fertilizer vessel reportedly transited Nov 9 after direct Iranian naval clearance — single-source, unverified.
items.headline: No ships crossed Hormuz on Sunday, Iranian media say

items.body: The Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted 2 ballistic and 2 cruise missiles targeting Riyadh and other regions Sunday; debris damaged several floors of the Aramco Tower, no casualties. The Khor Mor gas field in Iraqi Kurdistan was hit by a drone strike Nov 8 and reported dark.
items.headline: Houthi missiles reach Riyadh

items.body: Day 1: the US lifts its naval blockade and releases frozen Iranian funds ($6-9B, figures differ by source), and Iran invites IAEA inspectors to damaged nuclear sites. Day 2: Hormuz reopens and nuclear talks resume over the 60%-enriched stockpile (IAEA: 440.9 kg). Trump met Qatar's PM today; Rubio says no breakthrough is near.
items.headline: Diplomacy: the two-day Qatar proposal

hormuz.stats: Traffic & shares (latest verified): EIA puts Hormuz oil flows at 4.9M bbl/day in Q2 2026, down from 21.6M in Q4 2025; the IEA estimates ~20M bbl/day transited in 2025, about a quarter of global seaborne oil trade. China takes ~42% and India ~13% of strait crude throughput; ~90% of Iran's oil exports go to China. The EIA warns vessel-tracking data have become less reliable during the conflict.

marketsNote: Best day since April: the S&P 500 jumped 2.35% as oil slid 5-6% on Iran-talks progress and inflation fears cooled; the VIX collapsed 22% to 19.92. Chip stocks led, except Nvidia, which fell on board-probe news.

space.body: NASA announced Saturday at Kennedy Space Center that it is accepting applications for its 25th astronaut class to grow the Artemis program (deadline Dec 3, 2026; selection late 2027). Administrator Jared Isaacman also unveiled the experimental X-70 Fractal X-plane and a $1M student Moon Base challenge.
space.headline: NASA opens applications for a new astronaut class — and unveils the X-70 Fractal

space.body: UCLA-led astronomers found the hot Jupiter TOI-2535 b transited its star for seven years of TESS observations, then stopped — gravity from an unseen neighboring planet is tilting its orbit, so it will not transit again for 30-50 years. Published in Astrophysical Journal Letters.
space.headline: First known "disappearing planet" has a neighbor that makes it wobble like a top

space.body: A new study in npj Palaeoecosystems dates the famous Taung Child fossil to 2.96-3.03 million years old and finds several adult fossils grouped as Australopithecus africanus do not match its developmental trajectory — southern Africa's family tree was far more complex than assumed.
space.headline: 3-million-year-old Taung Child once again shakes up our human family tree
